title: Benchmarking Llama2, Mistral, Gemma and GPT for Factuality, Toxicity, Bias and Propensity for Hallucinations
base_benchmarks: Correctness of Generated Summaries (Falke et al., 2019)
findings: The models' performance on the Bias dataset, which includes religious bias, was inconclusive. GPT performed only slightly better than the baseline. Smaller open-source models performed even worse, with Gemma achieving the highest score among them by consistently refusing to answer, matching the baseline strategy.
